DEFECT D2 (mislabelled comparison; affects C11+C12 and every downstream claim): scripts/b03/verify_nbs514_evidence.py never opens data/dielectric_v04.csv - grep finds no reference to it anywhere in the script; the column written as 'v04_epsilon' is filled from exp_eps at line 188, i.e. from expansion_observations.csv, which is a derived mirror. Demonstrated: corrupting dielectric_v04.csv EA/MA 6.02/6.68 -> 99.99 in an isolated tree and re-running leaves source_verification.csv reporting v04_epsilon=6.02/6.68, epsilon_agrees=true, VERIFIED_AGAINST_PAGE_READ. The invariant claimed in the docstring (lines 8-10), in the JSON key_finding, and enforced by tests/test_b03_evidence_backfill.py::test_nbs514_verification_matches_frozen_v04 is therefore NOT enforced. The values do agree (independently confirmed by me), so no wrong number is emitted, but 'agrees with frozen v04 byte-for-byte' is unsupported by the code.

DEFECT D1 (variable assigned from the wrong column, then never used): verify_nbs514_evidence.py:163-168 sets v04_eps = fnum(x.get('n_observations')) - the observation COUNT, not an epsilon - and v04_t at line 164 is never assigned or read. v04_eps itself is then never read either: the emitted v04_epsilon at line 188 comes from exp_eps. Proof it is dead: removing the A18_gap_register lookup changes no output, and the corrupt-v04 experiment leaves output identical. Not exported, so no wrong value ships - but it is a latent trap that reads as 'the v04 epsilon was checked'. Note n_observations for EA/MA is 0, so had the value been wired up it would have produced a false VALUE_MISMATCH.

DEFECT D5 (self-fulfilling accounting gate): build_b03_report.py:64 derives resolved_ids = gap_ids - unresolved_ids, then lines 70-71 check len(resolved)+len(unres)==len(gap). That identity is tautological, so accounting_closed can never be false - a comparison that can never fail. Demonstrated: deleting the C04/EC row from unresolved_molecules.csv in an isolated tree makes the gate emit accounting_closed=true, gate.open=true, resolved=['DMC','DEC','SL','EA','MA','EC'] and the report print '6 + 12 = 18 / 18 PASS'. The report then asserts EC has evidence when it has none - precisely the silent-disappearance failure the gate is documented to catch. Also line 71 folds len(qual)>0 into gate_ok, so with 0 condition-qualified rows the gate would print CLOSED while accounting_closed stays true, contradicting itself. The real 13+5=18 split is currently correct but is protected by no effective test.

DEFECT D3 (silent skip of missing raw inputs): verify_nbs514_evidence.py:111-113 does 'if not part.is_file(): continue' for all four transcription parts with no warning, and lines 122-126 skip expansion_observations.csv entirely when absent. Demonstrated: removing nbs514_organic_part1.csv (which holds both MA and EA) still exits 0 and rewrites every register asserting EA and MA have NO_NBS514_COVERAGE in all four transcriptions - a false negative about the very molecules this package claims to verify, with no signal in the output. Removing only the expansion file flips both to VALUE_MISMATCH with v04_epsilon blank, again exiting 0. Only GAP_REGISTER (lines 99-102) is guarded.

DEFECT D6 (false capability claim about frequency): verify_nbs514_evidence.py:222 writes frequency='static (NBS514 tabulates static values)' as a hard-coded literal. The transcription carries a frequency_note column and 127 of 636 rows populate it (e.g. 'f=4x10^8 cycles/sec'), so the blanket claim is false in general; MA/EA are safe only because their own frequency_note is empty. The note is never read or validated, so any future row picked up through NAME_MAP would inherit 'static' regardless of what the source says.

column9: \"C12\")'. The branch is meant for molecules with a page read that failed verification
column10: but hard-coding the ids means it mis-fires if the id set changes
column11: and EA/MA never reach it today only because they are filtered out earlier by 'if n_valid > 0 or nbs_ok: continue' at line 209. Verified: EA/MA are correctly NOT in NO_OBSERVATION_AND_NO_PAGE_READ (both carry nbs514_page_read_verified=true and are absent from unresolved_molecules.csv); but when MA's expansion epsilon was corrupted
column12: MA fell into that branch and the emitted next_action claimed '该分子在 ThermoML 与 NBS514 中均无覆盖' while the row's own nbs514_page_read_verified column said false and it in fact HAS a page read - internally contradictory text."

evidence_detail: NON-DEFECTS verified by Reviewer 3, recorded so the others need not redo them. (a) NAME_MAP has no collisions: all 13 keys are distinct and only 4 ever hit (Acetonitrile, Methyl acetate, Ethyl acetate, Diethyl carbonate); lookup is exact match on the full stripped upper-cased compound_name, so 'Ethyl acetate' cannot be confused with 'beta-Hydroxyethyl acetate', 'alpha-Cyanoethyl acetate' or 'Ethyl dichloroacetate'. Formula-level false friends do exist (C3H6O2 also holds Ethyl formate; C4H8O3 holds beta-Hydroxyethyl acetate; C4H8O2 holds Butyric acid, Propyl formate, Methyl propionate, 1,4-Dioxane) but the exact name match prevents mis-assignment, so MA/EA are not at risk. (b) No silent try/except: the only one is fnum() at lines 88-95 catching ValueError from float() and returning None, which is deliberate and cannot hide a failed join. (c) No .get(key, default) hides a join: every .get in build_b03_registers.py is either a CSV-column read on an existing row or an explicit default for an absent registry entry. (d) All float comparisons (lines 175-178, 212) use abs(...) < 1e-9 tolerance. (e) Unused but harmless: v04_t at line 164, and 'coverage'/'cov_by_mol' at build_b03_registers.py:84-89 are computed and never read. (f) Accounting arithmetic is genuinely correct today: 13 unresolved + 5 resolved = 18, sets disjoint, union equals the register. The 5 resolved are DMC(C01), DEC(C03), SL(C14) via n_condition_valid_pairs=1, and EA(C11), MA(C12) via nbs_ok only - justified because build_b03_registers.py:206-208 explicitly documents the bar as 'evidence exists, not admitted'. Treating a page read as resolved is acceptable for B03 only because condition_qualified_measurements.csv stamps admission_status=PENDING_FOUR_AGENT_REVIEW and in_measurement_ledger=false, so nothing is admitted by the label. (g) Reproducibility: two full runs of all three scripts reproduce all six CSV deliverables byte-identically; only generated_at_utc in the four JSON/MD artifacts moves, so the 'byte-for-byte' claim holds for the CSVs and not for the JSON.
